scope: Read-only review during bootstrap_0005; no shared numerical source edits or new physical runs

findings.title: Zero-update imported BC success is exported as SAC
findings.detail: record_success stores online_updates but does not require them. Physical successes can precede learning_starts, and checkpoint writes a learned bootstrap SAC source label for all accumulated records. evaluate validates geometry/hash but unconditionally labels successful BC/checkpoint trajectories deterministic SAC.

findings.title: Accumulated training traces are not one frozen policy
findings.detail: Training updates occur between controls, episodes are pooled over history, and the exported file lacks a per-episode immutable actor identity. A positive update count at completion cannot show the entire episode came from one frozen SAC checkpoint.

findings.title: Extraction accepts missing or contradictory learner provenance
findings.detail: Physical metadata, frame counts and environment contract are validated, but not online counters, a common checkpoint hash, policy-only/SAC source, five40mm episodes, or independent force-audit file hashes. User-readable source string is copied into primitive provenance.

findings.title: Existing force-audit and joint-export CLIs are not one complete evidence bundle
findings.detail: audit_policy saves all2ms physics and commands, including each pre-command measured joint state, but no terminal joint frame or full obs/qpos/qvel transitions. evaluate saves initial+terminal joint frames but no force audit/actions and hardcodes4 Torch threads. It cannot be assumed bit-identical to a1thread policy collection without runtime and data comparison.

findings.title: Temporal alignment and exact five-trajectory source contract are absent
findings.detail: Extraction concatenates raw frames and performs PCA; no alignment metadata or five-episode requirement. Different-length episodes implicitly receive different weight. The authors alignment algorithm is unpublished.
